items.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019
items.q: we played some Chick Corea, we played “Freedom Jazz Dance”

ctx.x: That’s a good way to put it, processing power.

Oh my gosh. It was amazing. And so I loved my time, I learned a lot, I wish I had been a bit more mature, I would have learned more you know. I wish I had been really ready, a more mature musician, and when I entered the quintet you know I was a little young and restless and anxious to play my four mallet stuff you know. But I learned so much about music from George, and just sensitivity and certainly you know playing in an ensemble, ensemble playing, you have to be, as I indicated. But the music got a little,…
